input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting this fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi where I am, so I need my phone’s internet to work perfectly. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

I’d like to refuel the 2GB of data, please. I don’t want to change my plan—I just want my internet to be excellent again. The phone number I want to fix is 555-123-2002, that’s my number. What do I need to do next?

Thank you for adding the data. Before I do anything else, how can I check if my internet is actually excellent now? I really want to make sure it’s working perfectly before I try restarting or anything like that. Is there a way to test the speed?

I tried to check the speed, but it says there’s no connection. What should I do now? I really need my internet to be excellent, and I’m not sure why it’s still not working even after adding more data.
It looks like my phone is in Airplane Mode, and mobile data is not enabled. There’s also no cellular service showing. What should I do to fix this?

Yes, please! I get confused with these settings, so step-by-step help would be great. Can you walk me through turning off Airplane Mode and making sure mobile data is on? I really want to get this right.
Okay, I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. What should I do next to make sure my mobile data is on?
I’ve turned on mobile data now. What should I do next? I really hope this fixes it, because I still need excellent internet speed.
I’d like to run a speed test, please. I just want to see if my internet is excellent now. Can you help me with that?
I tried running the speed test again, but it still says there’s no connection. I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why isn’t this working even though I turned everything on? What should I do now?

Here’s what I found:
- My SIM card is active and working.
- The network mode is set to 2G only.
- Data Saver mode is turned on.

Does this mean something is set wrong? What should I change to get excellent internet speed?
Yes, please! I’d really appreciate step-by-step help with both of those things. I want to make sure I do it right so I can finally get excellent internet speed.
I’ve changed the network mode to prefer 4G and 5G, and I’ve turned off Data Saver mode. What should I do next to check if my internet is finally excellent? Should I try the speed test again?

I tried running the speed test again, but it still says there’s no connection. I’m really getting worried now—why isn’t it working even after all these changes? What else can I do to finally get excellent internet speed?
I’ve turned on data roaming now. Should I try the speed test again to see if my internet is finally excellent? Or is there something else I should do first?

I ran the speed test, and it says the connection is "good" with a speed of 27.50 Mbps. But I really need it to be "excellent"—is there anything else we can try to get it to that level? I don’t want to settle for just good.

I’m a bit nervous about rebooting—will I lose any of my photos or anything important if I do that? I really don’t want to risk losing anything just to get better internet. Can you reassure me about what happens when I reboot?
Okay, if you’re sure it won’t delete anything, I’ll give it a try. Can you please walk me through how to reboot my phone, step by step? I just want to make sure I do it right.
I’ve restarted my phone like you suggested. What should I do next to check if my internet is finally excellent? Should I run the speed test again?

I ran the speed test again after rebooting, but it still says the connection is "good" with 27.50 Mbps. I really need it to be "excellent." Is there anything else we can try? I don’t want to settle for just good internet.

I really don’t want to change my plan—I just want my current internet to be excellent. Could you please check if there are any network issues in my area first? I’m in France right now. Maybe that’s causing the problem?
Alright, I’ll wait. Thank you for your help so far—I really hope the next person can help me get excellent internet speed!
Thank you. I hope so too! Have a good day. ###TRANSFER###

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
